lines.start: Chef Mateo spins his wooden spoon faster and faster! Salsa spice clouds swirl everywhere!
lines.puffing: The spicy taco aroma puffs up even bigger across the meadow!
lines.fizzle: Poof! Every spicy fizz bubble pops into warm, tasty smells.

talk.label: Talk
talk.prompt: Chef Mateo lowers his wooden spoon... and listens.

lines.intro: Chef Mateo marches up waving a giant wooden spoon with swirly eyes! "EVERYBODY NEEDS MORE SPICE!"
lines.command: How can Fae calm Fizzy Chef Mateo?

soothe.great: Fae hums a cheerful suppertime tune. Chef Mateo's wooden spoon slows to a gentle stir!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. Chef Mateo pauses to tap his foot in rhythm.
soothe.miss: Chef Mateo clanks his wooden spoon right over Fae's humming!

play.great: Maddie bats a crispy tortilla chip high and catches it! Chef Mateo cheers "BRAVO!"
play.good: Maddie pounces after a dancing lime slice. Chef Mateo cracks a grin.
play.miss: Maddie skids on the clover and sneezes from a tiny pinch of cumin.

cast.great: Sue's ribbon loops like a festival bunting banner! Chef Mateo's eyes light up!
cast.good: Sue twirls her bright ribbon above the grass. Chef Mateo watches it sway.
cast.miss: Sue's ribbon catches a stray paper napkin and flutters away.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three golden limes in a perfect kitchen loop! Chef Mateo applauds!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a lime high and catches it cleanly. Chef Mateo nods approvingly.
juggle.miss: Jordan's lime rolls into the clover. Chef Mateo yells "FIVE SECOND RULE!"

lines.snack: Fae shares a crisp snack. Chef Mateo takes a taste-test bite and nods thoughtfully.
lines.burst: Chef Mateo tosses a flurry of crunchy taco-spice clouds toward Fae!

burstResult.great: Fae fans away every single spice cloud without a single sneeze!
burstResult.good: Fae brushes past most of the zesty spice clouds!
burstResult.miss: ACHOO! A zesty cloud of taco spice tickles Fae's nose!

lines.soothed: Chef Mateo blinks away the purple swirls and laughs warmly, wiping his apron clean!
lines.rest: Fae's nose is all tickled from the taco spice. Time for a quick rest.
lines.run: Fae steps back across the meadow while Chef Mateo loudly critiques the breeze.
